assessments.reasoning: The PDF retrieved from HCL Software's documentation site matched the frozen SHA-256. The cover gives the manual title and Version 7.51. Under What Is 4GL? on PDF page 25, printed 1-3, the manual classifies INFORMIX-4GL as a fourth-generation programming language and lists SQL-based database query and management facilities among its capabilities. Its discussion of database applications and two implementations on PDF pages 26 and 27 is consistent with the language-level descriptive claim.

challenge.method: Test whether the manual uses 4GL solely as the product name, or whether the listed database facilities concern a separate product. Read the definitions and nearby discussions of database use and implementations on PDF pages 25 through 27.
challenge.results: The definition expressly applies to the language. The manual separately describes its database use and identifies the C Compiler and the Rapid Development System as implementations of 4GL. The product framing is compatible with the scoped language identity.

limitations: The finding covers the language discussed in the Version 7.51 manual. Compiler, runner, database server, and vendor product identities have their own implementation boundaries.
